content: We’re excited to announce the general availability of Azure Ebsv6 and Ebdsv6 VMs, powered by 5th Gen Intel® Xeon® processors and Azure Boost, delivering enhanced storage performance for I/O-intensive workloads. Designed for relational databases, in-memory analytics, and data warehousing, these remote storage optimized VMs provide improved compute and storage performance over the previous generation. Key benefits include: Enhanced storage performance: Up to 800K IOPS and 12.5 GB/s remote storage throughput with Azure Boost, supporting Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disk. Improved efficiency: Up to 15% higher remote storage performance per vCPU and 15–30% improved CPU performance. High scalability: Up to 96 vCPUs and 768 GiB memory, with 192-vCPU sizes and up to 1.8 TB memory coming soon. Flexible configurations: Choose Ebsv6 for memory-intensive workloads or Ebdsv6 with local NVMe temporary storage. Enhanced security and connectivity: Up to 200 Gbps networking and Intel Total Memory Encryption enabled by default. Ebsv6 and Ebdsv6 VMs are now generally available across multiple Azure regions.
